readings.title: The Divisions of the Gatekeepers
readings.subtitle: Guardians of the Threshold
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 26:1] For the divisions of the gatekeepers: of the Qorḥites, Meshelemyahu son of Qore, of the sons of Asaph. [2] And Meshelemyahu had sons: Zekaryahu the first-born, Yeḏia‛el the second, Zeḇaḏyahu the third, Yathni’el the fourth, [3] Ělam the fifth, Yehoḥanan the sixth, Elyeho’ĕnay the seventh. [4] And Oḇĕḏ-Eḏom had sons: Shema‛yah the first-born, Yehozaḇaḏ the second, Yo’aḥ the third, and Sakar the fourth, and Nethan’el the fifth, [5] Ammi’el the sixth, Yissak_ar the seventh, Pe‛ullethay the eighth; for <dn>Elohim</dn> blessed him. [6] Also to Shema‛yah his son were sons born who ruled over their father’s house, for they were mighty men of bravery. [7] The sons of Shema‛yah: Othni, and Repha’ĕl, and Oḇĕḏ, and Elzaḇaḏ, whose brothers were brave men, Elihu and Semakyahu. [8] All these were of the sons of Oḇĕḏ-Eḏom, they and their sons and their brothers, able men with strength for the service: sixty-two of Oḇĕḏ-Eḏom. [9] And Meshelemyahu had sons and brothers, eighteen brave men. [10] And Ḥosah, of the sons of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief, for though he was not the first-born, his father made him chief; [11] Ḥilqiyahu the second, Teḇalyahu the third, Zekaryahu the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Ḥosah were thirteen. [12] Among these were the divisions of the gatekeepers, among the chief men, having duties just as their brothers had, to serve in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [13] And they cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their father’s house, for every gate. [14] And the lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemyahu. Then they cast lots for his son Zekaryahu, a wise counsellor, and his lot came out for the North Gate; [15] to Oḇĕḏ-Eḏom for the South Gate, and to his sons the storehouse. [16] To Shuppim and Ḥosah the lot came out for the West Gate, with the Shallek_eth Gate on the ascending highway – watchman over against watchman. [17] On the east were six Lĕwites, on the north four each day, on the south four each day, and for the storehouse two by two. [18] For the court on the west, four at the highway and two at the court. [19] These were the divisions of the gatekeepers among the sons of Qoraḥ and among the sons of Merari.

readings.title: Treasurers and Other Officials
readings.subtitle: The Dedicated Spoils of War
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 26:20] And of the Lĕwites, Aḥiyahu was over the treasuries of the House of <dn>Elohim</dn> and over the treasuries of the dedicated objects. [21] The sons of La‛dan, the sons of the Gĕreshunites of La‛dan, chief fathers of La‛dan the Gĕreshunite: YeḤi’ĕli. [22] The sons of YeḤi’ĕli, Zĕtham and Yo’ĕl his brother, were over the treasuries of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [23] Of the Amramites, the Yitsharites, the Ḥeḇronites, the Uzzi’ĕlites: [24] Sheḇu’ĕl son of Gĕreshom, son of Mosheh, was overseer of the treasuries. [25] And his brothers by Eli‛ezer were Reḥaḇyahu his son, and Yesha‛yahu his son, and Yoram his son, and Ziḵri his son, and Shelomoth his son. [26] This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated objects which King Dawiḏ and the chief fathers, the commanders over thousands and hundreds, and the commanders of the army, had dedicated. [27] From the battles and from the spoils they dedicated to maintain the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [28] And all that Shemu’ĕl the seer, and Sha’ul son of Qish, and Aḇnĕr son of Nĕr, and Yo’aḇ son of Tseruyah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomith and his brothers. [29] Of the Yitsharites, Kenanyahu and his sons performed duties outside Yerushalayim, as officers and judges. [30] Of the Ḥeḇronites, Ḥashaḇyahu and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred brave men, were over the duties of Yisra’ĕl on the west side of the Yardĕn, for all the work of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and for the service of the king. [31] Of the Ḥeḇronites, Yeriyahu was head of the Ḥeḇronites according to his genealogy of the fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of Dawiḏ they were sought, and mighty men of bravery were found among them at Ya‛zĕr of Gil‛aḏ. [32] And his brothers were two thousand seven hundred brave men, heads of fathers’ houses, whom King Dawiḏ made officials over the Reuḇĕnites, the Gaḏites, and the half-tribe of Menashsheh, for every matter of <dn>Elohim</dn> and the matter of the king.

readings.title: The Military Divisions
readings.subtitle: The Monthly Rotations of the Army
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 27:1] And the children of Yisra’ĕl, according to their number, the heads of fathers’ houses, the commanders of thousands and hundreds and their officers, served <dn>את</dn> the king in every matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, twenty-four thousand in each division. [2] Over the first division for the first month was Yashoḇ‛am son of Zaḇdi’ĕl, and in his division were twenty-four thousand; [3] of the sons of Perets, the head of all the commanders of the army for the first month. [4] Over the division of the second month was Doḏai an Aḥoḥite, and Miqloth was the leader in his division, and in his division were twenty-four thousand. [5] The third commander of the army for the third month was Benayahu, son of Yehoyaḏa the priest, a head, and in his division were twenty-four thousand. [6] This was the Benayahu who was a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and in his division was Ammizaḇaḏ his son. [7] The fourth for the fourth month was Asa’hĕl the brother of Yo’aḇ, and Zeḇaḏyahu his son after him, and in his division were twenty-four thousand. [8] The fifth for the fifth month was the commander Shamhuth the Yizraḥite, and in his division were twenty-four thousand. [9] The sixth for the sixth month was Ira son of Iqqĕsh the Teqo‛ite, and in his division were twenty-four thousand. [10] The seventh for the seventh month was Ḥĕlets the Pelonite, of the sons of Ephrayim, and in his division were twenty-four thousand. [11] The eighth for the eighth month was Siḇḇeḵai the Ḥushathite, of the Zarḥites, and in his division were twenty-four thousand. [12] The ninth for the ninth month was Aḇi‛ezer the Anthothite, of the Binyamites, and in his division were twenty-four thousand. [13] The tenth for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarḥites, and in his division were twenty-four thousand. [14] The eleventh for the eleventh month was Benayahu the Pir‛athonite, of the sons of Ephrayim, and in his division were twenty-four thousand. [15] The twelfth for the twelfth month was Ḥeldai the Netophathite, of Othni’ĕl, and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

readings.title: Leaders of the Tribes
readings.subtitle: The Census and the Oversight of the Nation
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 27:16] Furthermore, over the tribes of Yisra’ĕl: the officer over the Reḇuḇĕnites was Eli‛ezer son of Ziḵri; over the Shim‛onites, Shephatyahu son of Ma‛aḵah; [17] over the Lĕwites, Ḥashaḇyahu son of Qemu’ĕl; over the Aharonites, Tsaḏoq; [18] over Yehuḏah, Elihu, one of Dawiḏ’s brothers; over Yissak_ar, Omri son of Miḵa’ĕl; [19] over Zeḇulun, Yishma‛yahu son of Oḇaḏyahu; over Naphtali, Yerimoth son of Azri’ĕl; [20] over the sons of Ephrayim, Hoshea son of Azazyahu; over the half-tribe of Menashsheh, Yo’ĕl son of Peḏayahu; [21] over the half-tribe of Menashsheh in Gil‛aḏ, Yiddo son of Zekaryahu; over Binyamin, Ya‛asi’ĕl son of Aḇnĕr; [22] over Dan, Azar’ĕl son of Yeroḥam. These were the leaders of the tribes of Yisra’ĕl. [23] But Dawiḏ did not take <dn>את</dn> the number of those twenty years old and under, because <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had said <dn>He</dn> would increase Yisra’ĕl like the stars of the heavens. [24] Yo’aḇ son of Tseruyah began a census, but he did not finish, for wrath came upon Yisra’ĕl because of this census, and the number was not put into the account of the chronicles of King Dawiḏ.

readings.title: The Royal Property
readings.subtitle: Oversight of the King's Substance
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 27:25] And Azmaweth son of Aḏi’ĕl was over the king’s treasuries. And Yehonathan son of Uzziyahu was over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the towers. [26] And Ezri son of Keluḇ was over those who did the work of the field for tilling the ground. [27] And Shim‛i the Ramathite was over the vineyards. And Zaḇdi the Shiphmite was over the increase of the vineyards for the wine-cellars. [28] And Ba‛al-Ḥanan the Geḏerite was over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the low country. And Yo’ash was over the storehouses of oil. [29] And Shitrai the Sharonite was over the herds that fed in Sharon. And Shaphat son of Aḏlai was over the herds in the valleys. [30] And Oḇil the Yishma‛ĕlite was over the camels. And Yeḥdeyahu the Meronothite was over the donkeys. [31] And Yaziz the Hagrite was over the flocks. All these were the officials over the property of King Dawiḏ. [32] Also Yehonathan, Dawiḏ’s uncle, was a counsellor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. And Yeḥi’ĕl son of Haḵmoni was with the king’s sons. [33] And Aḥithophel was the king’s counsellor. And Ḥushai the Arkite was the king’s friend. [34] After Aḥithophel was Yehoyaḏa son of Benayahu, then Eḇyathar. And the commander of the king’s army was Yo’aḇ.

readings.title: David's Charge to Solomon
readings.subtitle: The Plan for the Dwelling Place
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 28:1] And Dawiḏ assembled <dn>את</dn> all the leaders of Yisra’ĕl: the leaders of the tribes and the commanders of the divisions who served the king, and the commanders over thousands and the commanders over hundreds, and the officials over all the property and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officials, and the mighty men, and all the brave men, unto Yerushalayim. [2] Then King Dawiḏ rose to his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! I had it in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and for the footstool of our <dn>Elohim</dn>, and had made preparations to build. [3] But <dn>Elohim</dn> said to me, <dq>‘You do not build a house for <dn>My</dn> Name, because you have been a man of battle and have shed blood.’</dq> [4] And <dn>YeHoVaH Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ĕl chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Yisra’ĕl forever. For <dn>He</dn> has chosen Yehuḏah to be the ruler, and in the house of Yehuḏah, the house of my father, and among the sons of my father, <dn>He</dn> was pleased with me to make me king over all Yisra’ĕl. [5] And of all my sons – for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has given me many sons – <dn>He</dn> has chosen my son Shelomoh to sit on the throne of the reign of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> over Yisra’ĕl. [6] And <dn>He</dn> said to me, <dq>‘Shelomoh your son is the one to build <dn>My</dn> house and <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dq> courts, for <dn>I</dn> have chosen him to be <dn>My</dn> son, and <dn>I</dn> am his Father.</dq> [7] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall establish <dn>את</dn> his reign forever, if he is strong to do <dn>My</dn> commands and <dn>My</dn> right-rulings, as at this day.’</dq> [8] And now, in the eyes of all Yisra’ĕl, the assembly of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and in the hearing of our <dn>Elohim</dn>, guard and seek all the commands of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, so that you possess this good land, and leave it as an inheritance for your children after you forever. [9] As for you, my son Shelomoh, know <dn>את</dn> the <dn>Elohim</dn> of your father, and serve <dn>Him</dn> with a perfect heart and with a willing mind, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> searches all hearts and understands all the intent of the thoughts. If you seek <dn>Him</dn>, <dn>He</dn> is found by you; but if you forsake <dn>Him</dn>, <dn>He</dn> rejects you forever. [10] See now, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has chosen you to build a house for the set-apart place. Be strong, and do it.” [11] Then Dawiḏ gave his son Shelomoh <dn>את</dn> the plans for the porch, and <dn>את</dn> its houses, and <dn>את</dn> its treasuries, and <dn>את</dn> its upper rooms, and <dn>את</dn> its inner rooms, and <dn>את</dn> the house of the atonement-cover; [12] and the plans for all that he had by the Spirit, of the courts of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and of all the rooms round about, of the treasuries of the House of <dn>Elohim</dn>, and of the treasuries of the set-apart objects; [13] and for the divisions of the priests and the Lĕwites, and for all the work of the service of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and for all the utensils of service in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; [14] for the gold, by weight for the gold, for all utensils of every kind of service; for all the silver utensils by weight, for all utensils of every kind of service; [15] and the weight for the lampstands of gold, and their lamps of gold, by weight for each lampstand and its lamps; and for the lampstands of silver by weight, for the lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand; [16] and by weight he gave gold for the tables of showbread, for every table, and silver for the tables of silver; [17] and pure gold for the forks, and the basins, and the jugs; and for the golden bowls by weight, for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight, for every bowl; [18] and for the altar of incense refined gold by weight, and gold for the model of the chariot, the keruḇim spread out their wings and covered the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn. [19] “All this,” said Dawiḏ, “<dn>He</dn> made me understand in writing, by <dn>His</dn> hand upon me, all the works of these plans.” [20] And Dawiḏ said to his son Shelomoh, “Be strong and of good courage, and do it. Do not fear nor be afraid, for <dn>YeHoVaH Elohim</dn>, my <dn>Elohim</dn>, is with you. <dn>He</dn> does not fail you nor forsake you, until you have finished all the work for the service of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [21] And see, the divisions of the priests and the Lĕwites are for all the service of the House of <dn>Elohim</dn>. And every willing man with skill is with you for any kind of service, for every work. And the officials and all the people are at your every command.”
